Hi Guys,

been learning and learning for months now after registering into RTM. I used to worship indicators and EAs but now im reverted back to basics again for some reasons. It's like a cycle and in the end you know a blank chart and some simple drawings is just enough, or far better than indicators. Just started my journal here, to record my mistakes and success in trading using IF methodology. There's still so much space for me to improve, but i would love to gather your feedback and ideas on my setups so i can add them into my learning process.

Thank you all!

از همهٔ شما ممنونم!

posts.t:
Hi,

each engulf has a target. Once that target is hit, your engulf is no longer usable. So make sure you identify a target for each engulf. This is one of the most crucial parts I think. I hope my comments are helpful.
posts.fa:
سلام،

هر اینگالف یک تارگت دارد. به محض اینکه آن تارگت زده شود، اینگالفت دیگر قابل استفاده نیست. پس حتماً برای هر اینگالف تارگتی مشخص کن. به نظرم این یکی از مهم‌ترین بخش‌هاست. امیدوارم نظراتم مفید باشد.

posts.t:
I'm really no expert on this yet unfortunately, but the target is the next FL on the same scale. Might be a QM, but might be other stuff (see lite video part1). Also, I'm starting to realize how much engulf/target and scale go hand in hand. What is an engulf in one scale is only a reaction in another. See my chart for an example.

Edit: sorry, i think it's in the part2 video, not the part1.
